'''Holo-tapestries''' were a form of artwork. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had an extensive collection of holo-tapestries in his collection rooms in the [[Emperor's Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].
